item_name: Rothco G.I. Type Combat Caps With Flaps - Olive Drab
item_short_desc: Embrace timeless classic fashion with Rothco’s Field Cap with Flaps. Crafted after the iconic patrol cap, this military hat features attached flaps, offering warmth and protection in cold weather, ensuring your head, ears, and neck is shielded from the elements.
